content:
The test image shows a serrated/lobed young leaf with brown, crumpled, and damaged areas particularly along the margins and tips. The leaf tissue appears partially eaten or stripped, with brown necrotic sections.

Comparing to the symptom descriptions:
- **Cutting_Weevil** matches perfectly: "Brown, curled and crumpled young leaves with visibly stripped shoots" — the leaf shows exactly this pattern of browning and crumpling at the margins/tips, consistent with weevil feeding damage on young leaves.
- Sooty_Mould (checked reference) shows black coating/encrustation — not present here.
- No white powdery growth (Powdery_Mildew), no galls (Gall_Midge), no dark sunken lesions (Anthracnose), no angular raised spots (Bacterial_Canker), no bark/twig dieback (Die_Back).
